summary.text: Sam Pfeifle is an independent candidate for the Maine House of Representatives, District 104, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Melissa Winslow. A Gray resident who works in the music industry and owns a bookstore, he has served on a school board for 12 years.

paragraphs.text: Sam Pfeifle earned a bachelor's degree from the University of Vermont in 1996, and his career experience includes working as a writer.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he said he lives in Gray in an 1870s house he and his wife bought in 2001, and that they raised two children who attended the Gray-New Gloucester schools.

He described a varied career as a teacher, writer, editor, journalist, publisher, musician, retailer and consultant, and said he currently works for a booking agency and helps operate a bookstore he owns with his sister.
Pfeifle said his service on the school board has lasted 12 years, and he signed the GoodParty.org Pledge.

Pfeifle said in the survey that his priorities are health care, housing and the changing climate, including a public option for health insurance in Maine, and that he is also passionate about education and the arts.
He said he is running as an independent in order to show that he is on everyone's side.
